briefdescription.para: Phase 5 network module hot-path release-gate benchmarks (NRG-01..NRG-06).

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for the network hot paths identified in the network module roadmap (Phase 5). Hard release gates — a p99 regression beyond 10 % vs the baseline blocks promotion.

sect2.title: Gate table
sect2.para:
All benchmarks:
Use kNetworkCanonicalSeed = 42.
Run with Repetitions(5).
No live sockets; all network I/O is mocked in-process.
